headline: Colonials Hold One Post in Callahan's Passage; Guns Busy at Nevish Line
war_summary: The heaviest file remains Palantine Berm, its seven posts standing six Warden to one Colonial, though the pace there has slackened from the furious exchanges of the small hours — three events in the past two hours against thirty-two across the day, with Leiri Hermanni and The Pippeli Stones carrying most of the traffic. Callahan's Passage is no longer wholly Warden: one Colonial post stands among nine, the latest filings falling at Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage as Colonial casualties in the last hour ran near 283. Nevish Line stays deadlocked at four Warden posts, three Colonial and one unclaimed, twenty-one events in the day and fresh activity at Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones. Stlican Shelf holds three Warden, five Colonial and one unclaimed, Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost busiest. Weathered Expanse, the twenty-four-hour leader at thirty-two events, has gone quiet since the previous evening, its posts two Warden to seven Colonial. At Gutter no posts have changed hands, yet casualties have surged on both sides — thirty-seven Colonial and twenty-two Warden in the past hour. Mooring County keeps eleven posts to one Colonial; Kuura Strand's six remain Warden and quiet. No victor has been declared.
